prerequisites: Knowledge of the structure of computer equipment and its operating system.
Ability to identify and describe the components that form computer systems.
Ability to manage their configuration, installation, removal, and updates to adapt them to the context of use.

learning_outcomes.text: Possess the capacity to design, develop, implement, manage, and improve products, systems, and processes in different industrial fields, using appropriate analytical, computational, or experimental techniques.
Apply acquired knowledge to identify, formulate, and solve problems in broad contexts, being capable of integrating them by working in multidisciplinary teams.
Basic knowledge about the use and programming of computers, operating systems, databases, and computer programs with application in engineering.
Possess learning skills that allow for continuous lifelong learning for adequate professional development.
Incorporate ICT and Industrial Engineering technologies and tools into their professional activities.
Implement examples and exercises of various kinds, in a numerical and alphanumeric context, that illustrate the concepts of efficiency and robustness, memory usage, and code reliability.
Ability to know, understand, and use the principles of computer programming, operating systems, application and use of databases, and computer applications.
Use the basic elements of C programming for solving elementary problems, handled manually.
Ability to design and program modular algorithms in C language that solve engineering-related problems.
Know, understand, and use the principles of programming using the C language.

syllabus_topics: Input and output functions. The stdio.h library
assessment_rules: Students have two opportunities to pass the course: an Ordinary call and an Extraordinary call. The Ordinary call offers two modalities: Progressive evaluation (default) consisting of three tests (30%, 30%, 40%) or a Global evaluation consisting of a single 100% exam for students who did not pass progressively. The Extraordinary call consists of a single 100% exam. To pass, a final grade of 5 or higher out of 10 points is required in any modality. All evaluation tests are C language coding exams performed in computer labs.
